title: [Mouse Without Borders] Service Mode fails in 0.102.3001.0 — works after rollback to 0.101.2362.0
summary: Merged #51789 covers the valid-but-different Microsoft certificate rejection tracked by #50795. Verify a build containing that change, while retaining #51971 as a distinct service-starts-without-listeners comparison. The new rollback to 0.102.2933 does not prove a shipped fix.

judgment.rationale: Merged #51789 covers the valid-but-different Microsoft certificate rejection tracked by #50795. Verify a build containing that change, while retaining #51971 as a distinct service-starts-without-listeners comparison. The new rollback to 0.102.2933 does not prove a shipped fix.
evidence: 0.102.3001 service-mode activation fails on Windows 10 and 11 while ordinary sharing works; rollback to 0.101.2362 restores it.
The report records valid Microsoft signatures alongside Settings IPC untrusted-signature rejections.
November 16 follow-up says reverting to 0.102.2933 restores its laptop service/startup behavior.
Live #50795 is open and documents signer-policy rejection between Settings and MWB: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/50795
Live PR #51789 is merged and replaces identical-leaf matching with independently trusted Microsoft signatures: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/pull/51789
Linked open #51971 describes service processes with no TCP listeners, which is not automatically the same signature failure: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/51971
